race.comment: Wide open. BRAIN WAVE (5) doesn't win out of turn but won't find a better chance for an overdue win. Safely held over 1200m fresh then ran a much improved race straight to 1800m in a richer race at Eagle Farm. Fitter again and back a notch. Gets chance to find form. TARTAN TIGER (3) was placed at Ipswich two back then was well off best last time. This suits and with ant luck from the wide gate can atone. PIGGIETALES (8) has solid prospects on best figures and this is easier. Doesn't win out of turn but senior rider on and should be finishing hard. MYSTICAL GEM (7) wasn't far away latest and should give a sight.
